senses.gloss: शुभ- + उदर्क शुभ- + उदर्क, adj., f. का, causing happiness, Kathās. 9, 58.

सु-भाषित-रस-आस्वाद-जात-रोमाञ्च-कञ्चुक सु-भाषित-रस-आस्वाद-जात-रोमाञ्च-कञ्चुक, adj. covered with a mail-like horripilation (a token of pleasure), produced by tasting the flavour of beautiful words, MBh. 12, 816.

सु- + भग सु- + भग,
 I. adj., f. गा. 1. fortunate, Chr. 287, 7 = Rigv. i. 48, 7. 2. beautiful, Vikr. d. 123; lovely, Śāk. d. 3; charming, d. 57. 3. beloved, amiable, Man. 2, 129.
 II. m. 1. the Aśoka tree. 2. the Champaca, Micelia campaka.
 III. f. गा. 1. a favourite woman. 2. a respectable mother. 3. the name of several plants.
 IV. n. fortune, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 19.
सु- + भट सु- + भट, m. a warrior (cf. भट्ट), Pañc. iii. d. 48.
सु- + भट्ट सु- + भट्ट, m.a very learned man, or perhaps rather a distinguished warrior, Lass. 29, 1 (in the latter case read सुभट, see भट).

सु- + भद्र सु- + भद्र,
 I. adj. propitious, fortunate, Ṛt. 1, 17 v. r.
 II. m. Viṣṇu.
 III. f. रा, The sister of जगन्नाथ.
सु- + भर सु- + भर, adj. 1. heavily burthened. 2. heavy, Chr. 296, 2 = Rigv. i. 112, 2 []. 3. f. रा, perhaps a proper name, Chr. 297, 20 = Rigv. i. 112, 20 (Sch. nourishing, viz. food).

सु- + भाषित सु- + भाषित,
 I. adj. 1. well spoken. 2. and n. well discoursing. Pañc. 31, 4, ii. d. 177.
 II. n. 1. eloquence. 2. a good advice(?), Man. 2, 239.
सुभिक्ष सुभिक्ष, i. e. सु-, n. abundance of food, Rājat. 5, 116; Pañc. iv. d. 82.
सु- + भीत सु- + भीत, adj. much afraid, Pañc. i. d. 20.
सु- + भृत सु- + भृत, adj. very lonely. ˚तम्, adv. 1. secretly, Hit. 86, 6. 2. privately, Hit. 73, 16 (in a very low voice?).
सु- + भृश सु- + भृश, adj. much, exceeding. ˚शम्, adv. much, excessively.

सु-भ्रू सु-भ्रू,
 I. adj. having fine brows, Vikr. d. 13.
 II. and सु-भ्रु, f. a woman, Lass. 90, 15 (ऊ); Sund. 4, 12 (ŭ).
सुभ्रु सुभ्रु, see भ्रू.
सु-भग- + मानिन् सु-भग- + मानिन्, adj. fancying one's self fortunate, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 12.
शुभ- + लग्न शुभ- + लग्न, m. (?), an auspicious moment, Hit. 94, 9.

1. शुभ् शुभ् (probably for original श्वभ्, cf. शुध्; see also शुम्भ्, s. v. 2. शुभ्), i. 1, Ātm., i. 6, Par.
 1. To shine, Chr. 40, 9.
 2. To be splendid, Rām. 2, 47, 17.
 3. To be beautiful, MBh. 4, 49.
 4. To be gay or happy, Pañc. iii. d. 226.
 5. † To hurt, to kill Ved. infin. शुभे, [] Chr. 290, 4 = Rigv. i. 64, 4.
 --Caus. शोभय, To cause to shine, to adorn, Rām. 2, 96, 31.
 --Ved. Caus. शुभय, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3.
 शोभित, Trimmed, Hit. iii. d. 27.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To shine, Pañc. i. d. 85.
 --Caus. To adorn, Rām. 1, 5, 16; Pañc. 159, 20.
 --With वि वि, To shine, Hit. ii. d. 71.
 --With सम् सम्, Caus. To adorn, Ṛt. 6, 23.

† 2. शुभ् शुभ्, शुम्भ् शुम्भ्, सुभ् सुभ्, सुम्भ् सुम्भ्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To speak, to shine.
 2. To kill, to hurt.
सुभ् सुभ्, sec 2. शुभ्.

शुभ शुभ् + अ,
 I. adj., f. भा.
 1. Splendid, Lass. 2. ed. 72, 5; beautiful, Pañc. iii. d. 185. Comparat. शुभतर, Very beautiful, Pañc. 226, 5.
 2. Distinguished, Lass. 2. ed. 59, 10.
 3. Learned.
 4. Happy, Hit. i. d. 5, M.M.; good, Pañc. iii. d. 106; virtuous, i. d. 150.
 II. m. One of the astrological Yogas.
 III. f. भा.
 1. A female friend of the goddess Umā, Rām. 3, 52, 26.
 2. Bambu manna.
 3. Bent grass.
 IV. n. Happiness, hail, Hit. 54, 17.
 --Comp.
शुभाशुभ शुभाशुभ, i. e. शुभ-अ-शुभ, adj. good or wicked, Pañc. ii. d. 18.
शुभंभावुक शुभंभावुक, i. e. शुभ + म्-भू + उक, adj. Resplendent, Lass. 67, 7.
शुभंयु शुभंयु, i. e. शुभ + म् + यु, adj. Happy, prosperous, Ragh. 8, 6.

शुभ्र शुभ् + र,
 I. adj.
 1. White, Megh. 53; Lass. 4, 17.
 2. Shining, bright, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3; Pañc. i. d. 252.
 II. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. Sandal, Padmap. 3, 4.
 III. f. रा.
 1. The Ganges.
 2. Crystal. []
 3. Bambu manna.
 IV. n.
 1. Silver.
 2. Talc.
 --Comp.
शुभ्रत्व शुभ्र + त्व, n. Whiteness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1915.
शुभ्रि शुभ् + रि, m. Brahman.
सुभाषितमय सु-भाषित + मय, i. e. (vb. भाष्), + मय, adj. Consisting in fine speeches, Pañc. ii. d. 176.
